**Best move:** Qe6+

**Main line:** Qe6+ Re3 (or Qe2 Qxe2+) Qxe3+ and Black wins material decisively.

**Motif:** fork

**Coaching note:**

When your opponent's king is exposed and your queen has multiple checks, calculate them all. Here, Qe6+ forks the king and both White defenders—the rook on h3 and queen on c2 can't both be saved. If White moves the rook, your queen captures it with check. If White defends with Qe2, you win the queen instead. Always look for checks that attack undefended pieces.
